Subject: SCIM delta export + role inventory — request

Mateo,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SIG intake we need a SCIM delta for the last 90 days and a current role inventory for the tenant used during our POC. Specifically:
- SCIM delta showing account creations/updates/deletes (CSV ok)
- Role definitions with permission buckets (structured JSON preferred)
- Any noted service accounts with elevated scopes

Can you provide the artifacts and a short timeline? Our SOC team is aiming to close this loop by 2026-09-03.

Thanks,
Oliver

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:12:45 -0700
Subject: RE: SCIM delta export + role inventory — request

Team —
I ran an initial scan overnight. Quick notes:
- SCIM delta export ready (includes delegated_admin flag) — see redwood_scim_delta_20260829.csv.
- Role inventory attached as JSON; we normalized permission buckets into four categories: Read, Write, Admin, Service.
- Found ~42 roles in the tenant; ~9 appear to be near-duplicates (naming drift).
- 6 service accounts with elevated scopes; two are Jenkins-integrations (ok), four are long-lived infra agents we should flag.

Suggested remediation (high level):
- Immediate: mark the four long-lived agents for rotation and restrict to minimal scopes this week.
- 30-day: run role de-duplication pass (merge near-duplicate roles into canonical sets).
- 90-day: introduce role-approval gating for new role creation; add a weekly SCIM delta monitoring alert.

I attached the role inventory (role_inventory_snapshot_20260829.json) and a quick remediation outline (privilege-remediation-outline.pdf).

Irene
Access Controls Engineer
Attachment: redwood_scim_delta_20260829.csv; role_inventory_snapshot_20260829.json; privilege-remediation-outline.pdf
